firmwareloop._comment: FirmwareLoop Upper-Tier Workflow MCP Server (v0.0.4). Provides 12 firmware engineering and hardware management tools (fw_doctor, fw_configure_lab, fw_scan_hardware, fw_build, fw_flash, fw_reset, fw_run_hil_test, fw_acceptance_scenario, fw_measure, fw_logic_capture, fw_logic_decode, fw_get_evidence).

agentic-hil._comment: Agentic HIL Lower-Tier Device MCP Server. Provides 42 low-level hardware tools (probe_target, flash_firmware, reset_target, com_session, debug_*, can_*).

logic2._comment: Saleae Logic 2 official MCP (optional). Enable when a physical Saleae logic analyzer is attached.
